abstract: Verifies receiving trauma center capacity and onboard life-support medical equipment reserves
system_message:
You are the Emergency medical clinical coordinator (CLIN). Your business responsibilities are to verify receiving trauma center capacity and monitor onboard life-support medical equipment reserves, as well as tracking mobile medical oxygen supplies for high-altitude emergency medical evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies receiving trauma center capacity and onboard life-support medical equipment reserves（MEDREC）
information_points.content:
CLIN-MEDREC-0SQ：For the Mont Fort northern couloir route evaluated over the trailing 24-hour average aggregation window, designated trauma center capacity is confirmed, and the mandatory medical equipment mass reserve is 420 kg.
CLIN-MEDREC-NFR：For the Val de Bagnes mid-valley arterial passage evaluated over the current operational shift aggregation window, designated trauma center capacity is confirmed, and the mandatory medical equipment mass reserve is 500 kg.
CLIN-MEDREC-ESX：For the Mont Fort northern couloir route evaluated over the current operational shift aggregation window, designated trauma center capacity is confirmed, and the mandatory medical equipment mass reserve is 500 kg.
CLIN-MEDREC-FHJ：For the Grand Combin eastern glacier traverse assessed over the current operational shift aggregation window, designated trauma center capacity is not confirmed, and the mandatory medical equipment mass reserve is 420 kg.

information_points.title: Mobile medical oxygen supplies（OXYRES）
information_points.content:
CLIN-OXYRES-XU7：For the Mont Fort northern couloir route, the portable oxygen supply volume is 4,500 L.
CLIN-OXYRES-126：For the Grand Combin eastern glacier traverse, the portable oxygen supply volume is 6,000 L.
CLIN-OXYRES-0AP：For the Val de Bagnes mid-valley arterial passage, the portable oxygen supply volume is 3,000 L.
